snippet.title: Renegade X 1.0 Release Trailer
snippet.description:
**Download here!!**
Totem Arts Game Centre - Renegade X - Totem Arts

https://totemarts.games/forums/files/file/140-totem-arts-game-centre/

The moment is finally here... Renegade X: "Release Version" !!

"Renegade X is a free Tactical Shooter that aims to bring the Command and Conquer: Renegade experience to the Unreal Engine. Players can join a 64 player server and fight for two unique teams - the Global Defense Initiative (GDI), a UN international military force committed to the new world order, and the Brotherhood of Nod, an international stateless network that aims to push humanity into the next stage of human evolution.

Originally set to be remake of Westwood Studios' "Command and Conquer: Renegade", Renegade X has evolved into a spiritual successor to the 2002 classic. Renegade X recreates and modernizes the game's unique multiplayer mode."

Many thanks to all the devs, past & present, who contributed to this amazing project over the years. 
And many thanks to all the fans and community members who continue to play and support the game!

A special note from FobbyGen: https://totemarts.games/forums/topic/81270-its-time-to-rock-n-roll/


https://totemarts.games
https://discord.gg/totemarts
https://twitter.com/TotemArtsStudio
https://www.facebook.com/TotemArtsOfficial
